WhatsApp API Documentation

Panduan lengkap integrasi WhatsApp API (Baileys) dengan berbagai framework dan bahasa pemrograman

Base URL API

http://localhost:3000

Semua request menggunakan WebSocket (Socket.IO) untuk komunikasi real-time. API dapat diakses secara publik di domain tersebut.

REST API Endpoints - Referensi Lengkap

Dokumentasi API Lengkap

Semua endpoint REST API yang tersedia di aplikasi WhatsApp Multi Session.

📚 Quick Navigation
🔐 Authentication 👥 Users 📱 Sessions 💬 Messages 📊 Logs 🗄️ Database 📝 Templates 🤖 Auto Reply 👥 Groups 📤 Exports ❤️ Health

🔐 Authentication API

Endpoint untuk autentikasi user, login, logout, dan manajemen sesi pengguna.
4 Endpoints
POST /api/auth/login Login user dan dapatkan session cookie
Publik

Autentikasi akun pengguna dengan email dan password. Mengembalikan cookie sesi wa_session serta data profil pengguna.

Otorisasi: Publik (Tidak Butuh Auth)
URL Endpoint: /api/auth/login
Parameter
Parameter Lokasi Tipe Keterangan
email wajib body string Alamat email pengguna terdaftar (contoh: admin@admin.com)
password wajib body string Kata sandi pengguna
Request Body application/json 
{
  "email": "admin@admin.com",
  "password": "admin123"
}
Respon API
200 OK / Berhasil 
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Login berhasil",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Administrator",
    "email": "admin@admin.com",
    "role": "adminwa",
    "token": "WATOKEN-..."
  }
}
400 Client Error 
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Email dan password wajib diisi"
}
401 Client Error 
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Email atau password salah"
}
Contoh cURL 
curl -X POST "http://localhost:3000/api/auth/login" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email":"admin@admin.com","password":"admin123"}'
Try It Out (Uji Coba Langsung)
Status: 200 OK 0 ms
Request URL:
POST /api/auth/logout Logout user dan hapus session
Session Cookie

Mengakhiri sesi login aktif dan menghapus cookie sesi wa_session.

Otorisasi: Session Cookie (wa_session)
URL Endpoint: /api/auth/logout
Parameter
Endpoint ini tidak membutuhkan parameter path atau query tambahan.
Respon API
200 OK / Berhasil 
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Logout berhasil"
}
Contoh cURL 
curl -X POST "http://localhost:3000/api/auth/logout" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Cookie: wa_session=YOUR_SESSION_COOKIE"
Try It Out (Uji Coba Langsung)
Status: 200 OK 0 ms
Request URL:

POST /api/auth/change-password Ganti password user sendiri
Session Cookie

Memperbarui kata sandi pengguna yang sedang login saat ini.

Otorisasi: Session Cookie / X-Session-Token
URL Endpoint: /api/auth/change-password
Parameter
Parameter Lokasi Tipe Keterangan
currentPassword wajib body string Password lama pengguna
newPassword wajib body string Password baru (minimal 6 karakter)
confirmPassword wajib body string Konfirmasi password baru (harus sama)
Request Body application/json 
{
  "currentPassword": "admin123",
  "newPassword": "admin Baru123",
  "confirmPassword": "adminBaru123"
}
Respon API
200 OK / Berhasil 
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Password berhasil diubah"
}
400 Client Error 
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Password baru tidak cocok dengan konfirmasi"
}
Contoh cURL 
curl -X POST "http://localhost:3000/api/auth/change-password" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Cookie: wa_session=YOUR_SESSION_COOKIE" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"currentPassword":"admin123","newPassword":"admin Baru123","confirmPassword":"adminBaru123"}'
Try It Out (Uji Coba Langsung)
Status: 200 OK 0 ms

👥 User Management API

Endpoint CRUD user, pembuatan akun member/admin, reset password, dan status user.
10 Endpoints
GET /api/users Dapatkan semua user dengan pagination & filter
Admin Cookie / X-Api-Key

Menampilkan daftar seluruh pengguna terdaftar, dilengkapi pagination, pencarian nama/email, dan filter role/status.

Otorisasi: Admin Cookie / X-Api-Key
URL Endpoint: /api/users
Parameter
Parameter Lokasi Tipe Keterangan
page opsional query number Nomor halaman pagination (default: 1)
limit opsional query number Jumlah user per halaman (default: 10)
role opsional query string Filter role: adminwa, memberwa, worker
status opsional query string Filter status: aktif, non-aktif
search opsional query string Kata kunci pencarian nama atau email
Respon API
200 OK / Berhasil 
{
  "success": true,
  "users": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Administrator",
      "email": "admin@admin.com",
      "role": "adminwa",
      "status": "aktif"
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 10,
    "total": 1,
    "totalPages": 1
  }
}
Contoh cURL 
curl -X GET "http://localhost:3000/api/users" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"
Try It Out (Uji Coba Langsung)

limit
role
status
search

POST /api/sessions/:sessionId/connect Connect / start session dengan QR Code
Session Cookie

Memulai proses inisialisasi koneksi sesi WhatsApp dan menghasilkan QR code untuk discan.

Otorisasi: Session Owner / Admin
URL Endpoint: /api/sessions/:sessionId/connect
Parameter

sessionId wajib path string ID sesi WhatsApp

💬 Messages & WhatsApp Send API

Endpoint pengiriman pesan teks, gambar, dokumen, tombol, dan broadcast WhatsApp.
10 Endpoints
POST /api/wa/send Kirim pesan teks WhatsApp (Auth: X-Api-Key)
X-Api-Key

Endpoint standar untuk mengirim pesan teks WhatsApp melalui integrasi aplikasi pihak ketiga (CRM, sistem POS, Webhook, dll).

Otorisasi: Header: X-Api-Key / X-Api-Token
URL Endpoint: /api/wa/send
Parameter
Parameter Lokasi Tipe Keterangan
to wajib body string Nomor tujuan (format: 628123456789 atau 628123456789@s.whatsapp.net)
message wajib body string Isi pesan teks yang ingin dikirim
sessionId opsional body string ID sesi WhatsApp pengirim (opsional, jika kosong menggunakan sesi aktif pertama)
Request Body application/json 
{
  "sessionId": "gudangtoko-main",
  "to": "6281234567890",
  "message": "Halo! Pesan konfirmasi pesanan Anda telah diproses."
}
Respon API
200 OK / Berhasil 
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Pesan berhasil dikirim.",
  "data": {
    "to": "6281234567890",
    "session_id": "gudangtoko-main",
    "msg_id": "3EB0..."
  }
}
400 Client Error 
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Field \"to\" dan \"message\" wajib diisi."
}
401 Client Error 
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "API Key diperlukan. Sertakan header X-Api-Key."
}
503 Server Error 
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Tidak ada sesi WhatsApp yang terhubung."
}
Contoh cURL 
curl -X POST "http://localhost:3000/api/wa/send" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: WATOKEN-YOUR-API-KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"sessionId":"gudangtoko-main","to":"6281234567890","message":"Halo! Pesan konfirmasi pesanan Anda telah diproses."}'
Try It Out (Uji Coba Langsung)
Kosongkan jika ingin menggunakan cookie sesi login Anda saat ini secara otomatis.
Status: 200 OK 0 ms
Request URL:
POST /api/wa/send-image Kirim gambar WhatsApp (Multipart atau JSON imageUrl)
X-Api-Key

Mengirimkan berkas gambar ke nomor WhatsApp tujuan. Mendukung upload file multipart/form-data maupun via JSON dengan URL gambar.

Otorisasi: Header: X-Api-Key / X-Api-Token
URL Endpoint: /api/wa/send-image
Parameter
Parameter Lokasi Tipe Keterangan
to wajib body string Nomor WhatsApp penerima
imageUrl opsional body string URL gambar publik (contoh: https://images.unsplash.com/...)
file opsional body file Upload file gambar (jika menggunakan multipart/form-data)
caption opsional body string Keterangan / caption di bawah gambar
sessionId opsional body string ID sesi WhatsApp pengirim
Request Body application/json 
{
  "sessionId": "gudangtoko-main",
  "to": "6281234567890",
  "imageUrl": "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1579202673506-ca3ce28943ef",
  "caption": "Bukti transfer invoice #INV-2026"
}
Respon API
200 OK / Berhasil 
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Gambar berhasil dikirim.",
  "data": {
    "to": "6281234567890",

POST /api/auto-reply Buat rule auto reply baru
Session Cookie

🔌 Socket.IO Events (Real-time)

Type Event Deskripsi Parameters
📤 Client → Server (Emit)
EMIT create-session Buat session baru sessionId
EMIT start-session-qr Start session dengan QR code sessionId
EMIT start-session-pairing Start session dengan pairing code { sessionId, phoneNumber }
EMIT logout Logout session sessionId
EMIT delete-session Hapus session sessionId
EMIT get-sessions Request semua sessions -
EMIT send-message Kirim pesan teks { sessionId, phone, message, tempId? }
EMIT send-image Kirim gambar { sessionId, phone, base64, caption?, mimetype?, filename?, tempId? }
EMIT send-video Kirim video { sessionId, phone, base64, caption?, mimetype?, filename?, tempId? }
EMIT send-document Kirim dokumen { sessionId, phone, base64, mimetype?, filename?, tempId? }
EMIT get-chat-history Request chat history { sessionId, phone, limit? }
📥 Server → Client (Listen)
ON all-sessions Daftar semua sessions sessions[]
ON qr QR code untuk scan { sessionId, qr }
ON pairing-code Pairing code untuk login { sessionId, pairingCode }
ON session-status Status session berubah { sessionId, status }
ON message-sent Pesan berhasil dikirim { success, sessionId, to, messageId, ... }
ON send-error Error saat kirim pesan { phone, tempId?, error }
ON incoming-message Pesan masuk baru { sessionId, from, message, timestamp, ... }
ON chat-history Riwayat chat { sessionId, phone, messages[] }
ON template-sent Template berhasil dikirim { success, sessionId, templateCode, ... }
ON template-not-found Template tidak ditemukan { phone, codes[], message }
ON error Error umum message
ON message Info/notifikasi message

Contoh Penggunaan REST API

cURL - Kirim Pesan Teks:
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/wa/send \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "sessionId": "wa-utama",
    "to": "6281234567890",
    "message": "Halo dari API!"
  }'

# Alternatif menggunakan endpoint /api/send-message (Guest Bearer Token atau X-Api-Key):
# curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/send-message \
#   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
#   -H "X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
#   -d '{"to": "6281234567890", "message": "Halo!"}'
cURL - Kirim Gambar:
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/wa/send-image \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "sessionId": "wa-utama",
    "to": "6281234567890",
    "imageUrl": "https://example.com/image.jpg",
    "caption": "Ini caption gambar"
  }'

# Atau kirim via multipart file upload:
# curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/wa/send-image \
#   -H "X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
#   -F "to=6281234567890" \
#   -F "caption=Ini caption gambar" \
#   -F "file=@/path/to/gambar.jpg"
PHP - Kirim Pesan:
<?php
$url = 'http://localhost:3000/api/wa/send';
$data = [
    'sessionId' => 'wa-utama',
    'to' => '6281234567890',
    'message' => 'Halo dari PHP!'
];

$ch = curl_init($url);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, true);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, json_encode($data));
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, [
    'Content-Type: application/json',
    'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'
]);
curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);

$response = curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);

$result = json_decode($response, true);
print_r($result);
JavaScript/Fetch - Kirim Pesan:
const response = await fetch('http://localhost:3000/api/wa/send', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'X-Api-Key': 'YOUR_API_KEY'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
        sessionId: 'wa-utama',
        to: '6281234567890',
        message: 'Halo dari JavaScript!'
    })
});

const result = await response.json();
console.log(result);
Response Sukses:
{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Pesan berhasil dikirim",
    "data": {
        "id": "3EB0...",
        "to": "6281234567890@s.whatsapp.net",
        "timestamp": 1706745600
    }
}
Response Error:
{
    "success": false,
    "error": "Session tidak ditemukan atau tidak terhubung"
}

1 Instalasi Library

Install Socket.IO client untuk PHP menggunakan Composer:

composer require wisembly/elephant.io

2 Buat Helper (Optional)

File: application/helpers/whatsapp_helper.php

<?php
defined('BASEPATH') OR exit('No direct script access allowed');

use ElephantIO\Client;
use ElephantIO\Engine\SocketIO\Version2X;

function send_whatsapp_message($sessionId, $to, $message) {
    $client = new Client(new Version2X('http://localhost:3000'));
    
    try {
        $client->initialize();
        
        $client->emit('send-message', [
            'sessionId' => $sessionId,
            'to' => $to,
            'message' => $message
        ]);
        
        // Listen for response
        $response = $client->wait('message-sent');
        
        $client->close();
        
        return [
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $response
        ];
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        return [
            'success' => false,
            'error' => $e->getMessage()
        ];
    }
}

File: application/controllers/Whatsapp.php

<?php
defined('BASEPATH') OR exit('No direct script access allowed');

class Whatsapp extends CI_Controller {
    
    public function __construct() {
        parent::__construct();
        $this->load->helper('whatsapp');
    }
    
    public function send_message() {
        $sessionId = $this->input->post('session_id');
        $to = $this->input->post('to');
        $message = $this->input->post('message');
        
        $result = send_whatsapp_message($sessionId, $to, $message);
        
        $this->output
            ->set_content_type('application/json')
            ->set_output(json_encode($result));
    }
    
    public function send_image() {
        $sessionId = $this->input->post('session_id');
        $to = $this->input->post('to');
        $imageUrl = $this->input->post('image_url');
        $caption = $this->input->post('caption');
        
        $client = new ElephantIO\Client(
            new ElephantIO\Engine\SocketIO\Version2X('http://localhost:3000')
        );
        
        $client->initialize();
        
        $client->emit('send-image', [
            'sessionId' => $sessionId,
            'to' => $to,
            'imageUrl' => $imageUrl,
            'caption' => $caption
        ]);
        
        $response = $client->wait('image-sent');
        $client->close();
        
        $this->output
            ->set_content_type('application/json')
            ->set_output(json_encode($response));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Libraries;

use ElephantIO\Client;
use ElephantIO\Engine\SocketIO\Version2X;

class WhatsappService {
    
    protected $client;
    protected $serverUrl = 'http://localhost:3000';
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->client = new Client(new Version2X($this->serverUrl));
    }
    
    public function sendMessage($sessionId, $to, $message) {
        try {
            $this->client->initialize();
            
            $this->client->emit('send-message', [
                'sessionId' => $sessionId,
                'to' => $to,
                'message' => $message
            ]);
            
            $response = $this->client->wait('message-sent');
            $this->client->close();
            
            return [
                'success' => true,
                'data' => $response
            ];
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ];
        }
    }
    
    public function sendImage($sessionId, $to, $imageUrl, $caption = '') {
        try {
            $this->client->initialize();
            
            $this->client->emit('send-image', [
                'sessionId' => $sessionId,
                'to' => $to,
                'imageUrl' => $imageUrl,
                'caption' => $caption
            ]);
            
            $response = $this->client->wait('image-sent');
            $this->client->close();
            
            return [
                'success' => true,
                'data' => $response
            ];
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ];
        }
    }
    
    public function getSessions() {
        try {
            $this->client->initialize();
            $this->client->emit('get-sessions');
            $response = $this->client->wait('all-sessions');
            $this->client->close();
            
            return [
                'success' => true,
                'data' => $response
            ];
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ];
        }
    }
}

3 Controller

File: app/Http/Controllers/WhatsappController.php

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Services\WhatsappService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class WhatsappController extends Controller {
    
    protected $whatsapp;
    
    public function __construct(WhatsappService $whatsapp) {
        $this->whatsapp = $whatsapp;
    }
    
    public function sendMessage(Request $request) {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'session_id' => 'required|string',
            'to' => 'required|string',
            'message' => 'required|string'
        ]);
        
        $result = $this->whatsapp->sendMessage(
            $validated['session_id'],
            $validated['to'],
            $validated['message']
        );
        
        return response()->json($result);
    }
    
    public function sendImage(Request $request) {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'session_id' => 'required|string',
            'to' => 'required|string',
            'image_url' => 'required|url',
            'caption' => 'nullable|string'
        ]);
        
        $result = $this->whatsapp->sendImage(
            $validated['session_id'],
            $validated['to'],
            $validated['image_url'],
            $validated['caption'] ?? ''
        );
        
        return response()->json($result);
    }
}

2 Buat Service/Utility

File: lib/whatsapp.js

import { io } from 'socket.io-client'

let socket = null

export const connectSocket = () => {
  if (!socket) {
    socket = io('http://localhost:3000')
  }
  return socket
}

export const sendMessage = (sessionId, to, message) => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const socket = connectSocket()
    
    socket.emit('send-message', {
      sessionId,
      to,
      message
    })
    
    socket.once('message-sent', (response) => {
      resolve(response)
    })
    
    socket.once('error', (error) => {
      reject(error)
    })
    
    // Timeout after 30 seconds
    setTimeout(() => {
      reject(new Error('Request timeout'))
    }, 30000)
  })
}

export const sendImage = (sessionId, to, imageUrl, caption = '') => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const socket = connectSocket()
    
    socket.emit('send-image', {
      sessionId,
      to,
      imageUrl,
      caption
    })
    
    socket.once('image-sent', (response) => {
      resolve(response)
    })
    
    socket.once('error', (error) => {
      reject(error)
    })
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      reject(new Error('Request timeout'))
    }, 30000)
  })
}

export const getSessions = () => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const socket = connectSocket()
    
    socket.emit('get-sessions')
    
    socket.once('all-sessions', (sessions) => {
      resolve(sessions)
    })
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      reject(new Error('Request timeout'))
    }, 10000)
  })
}

3 API Route (App Router)

File: app/api/whatsapp/send-message/route.js

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { sendMessage } from '@/lib/whatsapp'

export async function POST(request) {
  try {
    const { sessionId, to, message } = await request.json()
    
    if (!sessionId || !to || !message) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Missing required fields' },
        { status: 400 }
      )
    }
    
    const result = await sendMessage(sessionId, to, message)
    
    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      data: result
    })
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error.message },
      { status: 500 }
    )
  }
}

4 Implementasi di Component

File: components/SendMessage.jsx

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'

export default function SendMessage() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    sessionId: 'session1',
    to: '',
    message: ''
  })
  
  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/whatsapp/send-message', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(formData)
      })
      
      const result = await response.json()
      
      if (result.success) {
        alert('Pesan berhasil dikirim!')
        setFormData({ ...formData, to: '', message: '' })
      } else {
        alert('Gagal mengirim pesan: ' + result.error)
      }
    } catch (error) {
      alert('Error: ' + error.message)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }
  
  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
      <input
        type="text"
        placeholder="Session ID"
        value={formData.sessionId}
        onChange={(e) => setFormData({...formData, sessionId: e.target.value})}
        className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
      />
      
      <input
        type="text"
        placeholder="Nomor WhatsApp (628xxx)"
        value={formData.to}
        onChange={(e) => setFormData({...formData, to: e.target.value})}
        className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
      />
      
      <textarea
        placeholder="Pesan"
        value={formData.message}
        onChange={(e) => setFormData({...formData, message: e.target.value})}
        className="w-full p-2 border rounded"
        rows="4"
      />
      
      <button
        type="submit"
        disabled={loading}
        className="w-full bg-blue-500 text-white p-2 rounded hover:bg-blue-600"
      >
        {loading ? 'Mengirim...' : 'Kirim Pesan'}
      </button>
    </form>
  )
}

const socket = io('http://localhost:3000')

export default {
  install(app) {
    app.config.globalProperties.$socket = socket
    
    app.config.globalProperties.$whatsapp = {
      sendMessage(sessionId, to, message) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          socket.emit('send-message', { sessionId, to, message })
          
          socket.once('message-sent', (response) => {
            resolve(response)
          })
          
          socket.once('error', (error) => {
            reject(error)
          })
          
          setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Timeout')), 30000)
        })
      },
      
      sendImage(sessionId, to, imageUrl, caption = '') {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          socket.emit('send-image', { sessionId, to, imageUrl, caption })
          
          socket.once('image-sent', (response) => {
            resolve(response)
          })
          
          socket.once('error', (error) => {
            reject(error)
          })
          
          setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Timeout')), 30000)
        })
      },
      
      getSessions() {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          socket.emit('get-sessions')
          
          socket.once('all-sessions', (sessions) => {
            resolve(sessions)
          })
          
          setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Timeout')), 10000)
        })
      }
    }
  }
}

3 Kirim Pesan

File: send_message.php

<?php
require_once 'config.php';

header('Content-Type: application/json');

try {
    // Get POST data
    $sessionId = $_POST['session_id'] ?? null;
    $to = $_POST['to'] ?? null;
    $message = $_POST['message'] ?? null;
    
    if (!$sessionId || !$to || !$message) {
        throw new Exception('Missing required fields');
    }
    
    // Connect to Socket.IO server
    $client = new Client(new Version2X(SOCKET_SERVER));
    $client->initialize();
    
    // Emit message
    $client->emit('send-message', [
        'sessionId' => $sessionId,
        'to' => $to,
        'message' => $message
    ]);
    
    // Wait for response (optional)
    $response = $client->wait('message-sent');
    
    // Close connection
    $client->close();
    
    echo json_encode([
        'success' => true,
        'data' => $response
    ]);
    
} catch (Exception $e) {
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode([
        'success' => false,
        'error' => $e->getMessage()
    ]);
}

        'to' => $to,
        'imageUrl' => $imageUrl,
        'caption' => $caption
    ]);
    
    $response = $client->wait('image-sent');
    $client->close();
    
    echo json_encode([
        'success' => true,
        'data' => $response
    ]);
    
} catch (Exception $e) {
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode([
        'success' => false,
        'error' => $e->getMessage()
    ]);
}

1 Instalasi Package 

npm install socket.io-client express

2 Buat Wrapper Service

File: whatsapp-service.js

const { io } = require('socket.io-client')

class WhatsappService {
  constructor(serverUrl = 'http://localhost:3000') {
    this.socket = io(serverUrl)
    
    this.socket.on('connect', () => {
      console.log('✅ Connected to WhatsApp server')
    })
    
    this.socket.on('disconnect', () => {
      console.log('❌ Disconnected from WhatsApp server')
    })
  }
  
  sendMessage(sessionId, to, message) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.socket.emit('send-message', {
        sessionId,
        to,
        message
      })
      
      this.socket.once('message-sent', (response) => {
        resolve(response)
      })
      
      this.socket.once('error', (error) => {
        reject(error)
      })
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        reject(new Error('Request timeout'))
      }, 30000)
    })
  }
  
  sendImage(sessionId, to, imageUrl, caption = '') {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.socket.emit('send-image', {
        sessionId,
        to,
        imageUrl,
        caption
      })
      
      this.socket.once('image-sent', (response) => {
        resolve(response)
      })
      
      this.socket.once('error', (error) => {
        reject(error)
      })
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        reject(new Error('Request timeout'))
      }, 30000)
    })
  }
  
  getSessions() {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.socket.emit('get-sessions')
      
      this.socket.once('all-sessions', (sessions) => {
        resolve(sessions)
      })
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        reject(new Error('Request timeout'))
      }, 10000)
    })
  }
  
  createSession(sessionId, method = 'qr', phoneNumber = null) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      this.socket.emit('create-session', {
        sessionId,
        method,
        phoneNumber
      })
      
      if (method === 'qr') {
        this.socket.once('qr', (data) => {
          resolve(data)
        })
      } else {
        this.socket.once('pairing-code', (data) => {
          resolve(data)
        })
      }
      
      this.socket.once('error', (error) => {
        reject(error)
      })
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        reject(new Error('Request timeout'))
      }, 60000)
    })
  }
}

module.exports = WhatsappService

3 Express API Server

File: server.js

const express = require('express')
const WhatsappService = require('./whatsapp-service')

const app = express()
const whatsapp = new WhatsappService()

app.use(express.json())
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }))

// Send message endpoint
app.post('/api/send-message', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { sessionId, to, message } = req.body
    
    if (!sessionId || !to || !message) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Missing required fields'
      })
    }
    
    const result = await whatsapp.sendMessage(sessionId, to, message)
    
    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: result
    })
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: error.message
    })
  }
})

// Send image endpoint
app.post('/api/send-image', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { sessionId, to, imageUrl, caption } = req.body
    
    if (!sessionId || !to || !imageUrl) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        error: 'Missing required fields'
      })
    }
    
    const result = await whatsapp.sendImage(sessionId, to, imageUrl, caption || '')
    
    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: result
    })
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: error.message
    })
  }
})

// Get sessions endpoint
app.get('/api/sessions', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const sessions = await whatsapp.getSessions()
    
    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: sessions
    })
  } catch (error) {
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      error: error.message
    })
  }
})

const PORT = process.env.PORT || 4000

app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`🚀 Server running on http://localhost:${PORT}`)
})
